content.short: Foundry Rust Template uses Foundry to build EVM smart contracts in Rust.
content.description: Foundry Rust Template creates Rust-based smart contracts projects that use Foundry for the EVM. The repository provides two ready-to-run workflows for developers: one for Solidity and one for Rust, with CI already integrated to streamline validation, testing, and deployment. It offers a practical quickstart for Foundry-based initiatives, enabling teams to prototype across language targets while keeping project setup simple, reproducible, and easy to extend.
content.meta: Foundry Rust Template lets you build EVM smart contracts in Rust with Foundry. Discover Foundry Rust Template and other Solidity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
